subject: Lighting inside and around cabinetry
hook: Forgot the lighting? It can often go in later.
fb:
"We can't stretch to lighting right now. Can we add it later?"

Often, yes. Under the wall units is the easiest place to retrofit. The catch is that without routes planned in, cables can end up visible or panels need drilling on site.

So here's our advice: if there's any chance you'll want lighting, mention it at the design stage. We can leave the cable routes and driver spaces ready in the units, and you add the lights whenever suits you.

Got a kitchen question? Ask us in the comments or book a free design consultation below.

gbp:
Can lighting be added to kitchen units after they're fitted? Often, yes — but it's much neater if it's planned in from the start.

Under wall units is the easiest place to retrofit lighting. Elsewhere, such as plinths or inside tall larders, adding lights later can mean visible cables or drilling finished panels on site.

If you think you might want lighting at some point, mention it at your design consultation. We can build the cable routes and driver spaces into your cabinets in our workshop, ready for your electrician whenever you decide to go ahead.

SUPERIO designs, makes and installs bespoke kitchens for homes across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire. Book a free, no-obligation design consultation and itemised quote.
